name: ember-theme
description: A warm, dark-only theme for long sessions: red-black surfaces, bone text and the colours of a fire, over a hearth that glows at the foot of the window. No blue anywhere.

glow.title: Hearth
glow.description: A bed of coals glowing at the foot of the window, behind frosted panels. Off gives a flat background.

sparks.title: Sparks
sparks.description: A few sparks drifting slowly up from the hearth. Off keeps the glow still. Your system's reduce-motion setting turns them off too.
